system.description: Global build system for this package. Use "auto" for automatic detection or specify a system name.

commands.description: Per-command overrides. Keys are command names (e.g. "build", "test").

hooksDir.description: Directory to scan for convention-based hook scripts. Relative paths are resolved from the package root.

hooks.description: Explicit hook definitions. Keys are "pre<command>" or "post<command>". Values are either a build system name (to delegate to that system) or a shell command string.

additionalProperties.description: A build system name (e.g. "cargo", "npm") or a shell command (e.g. "./scripts/gen.sh").

commandConfig.description: Override configuration for a specific command.

system.description: Override the build system for just this command.

exec.description: Full exec override: replaces the entire argv for this command.
